2. Second at line 11: getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName())

Since zipEntry.getName() returns the same value in both cases, and name is calculated using zipEntry.getName() (which equals tmp1), the value of name at line 11 does depend on the value of tmp1 that was computed at line 2.
